answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a small, nontransferable deposit that is forfeited when peers prove it double-signed a task or fabricated a result. A rotating committee checks signed interaction receipts against a public cipher log; honest agents earn fees, while proven fraud burns the bond. Spawning a hundred saffron or lotus personas therefore requires a hundred funded deposits, and coordinating them risks losing every bond, making Sybil influence costly rather than free.
